messages.subject: subset of a vector
messages.body_plain:
I'm hoping that someone is getting messages from this list.  I'm trying to work out how to get a vector which is a subset of another vector.  I saw how I can get .tail and .head but I'm looking for something more arbitrary. In R I can do the following:

x=1:10
x[c(1,3,5,7)]

In ADMB I can assign values to a vector ind and then use x(ind).  Was looking to do that in TMB. I tried but got an error at compile. Help?

messages.body_plain: With regard to my last post, I realize that I can do it as a loop.  I've encountered one other ADMB construct I use and wonder whether there is the equivalent to a ragged matrix? I've not been able to find one and considering there isn't subscript limits on matrices I presume there isn't one and I'll just construct a rectangular matrix with the largest size of all rows.

messages.body_plain:
